name: Awatar
author: awatarinovations

sections.description:
Awatar is a no-code AI chatbot platform designed to help organizations deploy intelligent assistants quickly and affordably, without needing technical expertise. It operates across various channels like WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Web, and Email, ensuring seamless conversations.

Key Features:
Enhanced Customer Service: 24/7 availability, fast responses, and multilingual support.
Cost Efficiency: Smaller support teams, simultaneous multi-user handling, and reduced hiring costs.
Improved Lead Generation: Engages users interactively and qualifies leads automatically.
How It Works:
Conversation Tool: Processes incoming messages.
Knowledge Base: Searches for relevant answers.
Agent/Persona: Coordinates the search and holds personality traits.
AI Model: Produces intelligent, contextual responses.
Awatar is not just another chatbot builder; it’s a gateway to scalable, intelligent conversations that drive real outcomes!

External services

This plugin connects to the Awatar Chat API at api.awatar.chat to manage and enhance chatbot functionality. It uses the following endpoints:

  • Activate/Deactivate Chatbot (http://api.awatar.chat/api/wp/activate/chatbot): Sends the chatbot’s name to activate or deactivate it. When deactivated, the chatbot icon will not appear on the site.
  • Single Post Update (http://api.awatar.chat/api/wp/post): Triggered whenever a post is published or updated; sends the post URL for ingestion into the chatbot’s knowledge library.
  • Multiple Posts Update (http://api.awatar.chat/api/wp/post/multi): Sends up to 150 post URLs present on the site for bulk ingestion into the chatbot’s knowledge library.
  • Onboarding Progress (http://api.awatar.chat/api/wp): Retrieves the site’s onboarding process progress.
  • Start Onboarding (http://api.awatar.chat/api/wp/activate): Initiates the onboarding process by sending the user-entered license key.

All API requests include a site key, the site’s URL, and, when required, the admin’s email address to verify and authenticate the request.

This service is provided by “Awatar Innovations Sdn. Bhd.”:
– Terms and Conditions: https://app.awatar.chat/terms-and-conditions
– Privacy Policy: https://app.awatar.chat/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
• Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer.
  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  • Click on the \\”Awatar\\” menu on activation and follow the instructions given on how to obtain a license key.
  • Enter the obtained license key into the input field and begin the activation process.
  • Activation will take about 5-10 minutes to complete. Once completed click on Activate Chatbot to start seeing the chatbot
  • For a more comprehensive guide please visit: https://www.awatar.chat/wp-guide
sections.faq:
What kind of content can Awatar read?
– Awatar reads your public posts, pages, and FAQs to provide helpful, context-aware answers.
Is it multilingual?
– Yes! Awatar can understand and respond in multiple languages, based on the user’s request.
Can I add more knowledge manually?
– Absolutely. You can log in to the Awatar dashboard and upload custom documents, links, or content.
Do I need to code anything?
– Not at all. Awatar was designed for non-technical users — install it and it just works.
Will Awatar work with my existing WordPress theme?
– Yes! Awatar is built to be fully compatible with all modern WordPress themes. It integrates seamlessly without affecting your site’s design or layout.
